periocular_spatial_geometry.dominant_axis_orientation: Diagonal orientation with the primary axis angled approximately 45 degrees downward from the lateral periphery toward the rostrum.
periocular_spatial_geometry.aspect_ratio_factor: Elongated oval morphology with a visual height-to-width ratio of approximately 2:1.
periocular_spatial_geometry.inferior_centroid_shift: Clear downward tapering where the patch center of mass is visually shifted towards the lower-medial quadrant near the snout.

dorsal_band_topology.normalized_band_thickness: The dark fur region at the lateral shoulder transition occupies approximately 35% of the visible torso height.

cranial_pinna_bounding_metrics.inter_bounding_box_euclidean_distance: A wide separation between the black ear regions, approximately equivalent to 1.5 times the horizontal width of a single pinna.
cranial_pinna_bounding_metrics.apex_contour_smoothness: Smoothly curved semicircular apex on both the left and right pinna.

other_distinctive_markers: Significant yellowish-brown chromophoric variation/staining across the ventral and abdominal white fur regions.
